purpose: Keep the executable fixed-kappa source-coordinate profile packet F(X,eta), U(X,eta), E(X,eta) separate from a physical Cartesian velocity(x,y,z,t)->[u,v,w] delivery identity.

canonical_constraints.boundary: smooth zero extension of velocity and pressure outside support
residual_norms: volume-weighted L2 spatial norm at each time

user_requirement: The highest-priority delivery is an explicit callable and save/load 3D time-dependent velocity(x,y,z,t)->[u,v,w].
Callable velocity delivery is governed independently from visual correspondence, PDE validation, paper exactness, and OpenAI-field identity.
User requirements, public-source facts, autonomous design, and pending/unknown information remain separate.
public_source_fact: As registered by Agent 1 #925 from the pinned corrected public reader, the fixed-kappa continuation uses partial_X log(F)=-kappa_0*p1r/(2X), partial_X U=-kappa_0*nsr/2, and E=sqrt(2X)*F on its stated source-coordinate interval.
As registered by Agent 1 #925, the displayed fixed-kappa shear schedule is kappa_0*(p1r,p2r*E_r/E).
autonomous_design: The current executable continuation freezes repository-autonomous kappa_0=0.1, uses the repository-autonomous pressure-derived reference stress, and evaluates the radial integrals with fixed Gauss-Legendre order 48.
Agent 4 #928 independently audits save/reloaded public F/U/E values with a centered eighth-order X finite-difference operator.
The two-component-map counterexample in this CR002 increment is mechanics-only and is not Kokuno/OpenAI candidate evidence.
pending_unknown: A repository-level executable pullback that binds this exact profile artifact to physical inputs (x,y,z,t) and returns Cartesian [u,v,w].
A profile-artifact-bound source-coordinate-to-cylindrical/Cartesian component map, including any required azimuthal/time/scaling factors.
An axis-regular Cartesian branch or limiting rule for the resulting physical velocity provider.
The final X=100 to X=110 bridge, corrected/global leading join and declared support/extension needed for a global physical velocity artifact.
A save/load semantic identity for the actual Kokuno Cartesian velocity provider rather than only the source-coordinate profile configuration.

Matched Cartesian pressure/grad p, preregistered restricted forcing, real correction velocity, complete held-out NS residual, visual correspondence, PDE validation, paper exactness, and exact OpenAI-field identity.

cartesian_velocity_delivery_requirements: A callable physical-input API velocity(x,y,z,t)->[u,v,w] with explicit units/domain/time semantics.
An executable coordinate/time pullback from physical (x,y,z,t) into every source-coordinate variable consumed by the exact profile artifact.
An explicit component/scaling map from profile quantities to cylindrical and then Cartesian velocity components, bound to the same profile semantic identity.
A finite axis branch or mathematically defined r->0 limit wherever cylindrical-to-Cartesian conversion is singular.
A complete/global join and support/extension rule covering the declared physical delivery domain rather than only X_1<=X<=100.
Save/load identity and candidate SHA bound to the actual Cartesian velocity provider/artifact, not merely to F/U/E profile configuration.
Independent state flags so exportability cannot promote visual correspondence, PDE validation, paper exactness, or OpenAI-field identity.

mechanics_witness.interpretation: The same scalar profile payload can produce different Cartesian vectors when the component map is not part of the artifact identity; this is only a logical witness and does not assert ambiguity in the public Kokuno formulas.

non_changes: No F/U/E value, derivative, kappa_0, stress, pressure, forcing, coefficient, optimizer, sample, source formula, artifact byte, or scientific threshold is modified.
No residual-defined f=R shortcut, amplitude collapse, post-hoc threshold relaxation, or visual-to-PDE/exactness promotion is introduced.

This scope does not say a source-coordinate profile is useless; it only prevents profile identity from being relabeled as Cartesian velocity-delivery identity before the missing representation contract is executable and bound.
